grammar.title: There be句型的过去式
grammar.structure: There was/were + 名词 + 地点/时间
grammar.definition: There be句型用于表示某地存在某人或某物，过去式分别用There was（单数）和There were（复数） 描述过去某处存在的人或物，注意there was后接单数名词，there were后接复数名词

examples.en: There was a very big race in 1995.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were hundreds of people there.

grammar.title: 一般过去时（Simple Past Tense）
grammar.structure: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态，动词用过去式 描述过去发生的事情，常见的过去式变化包括：规则动词加-ed，不规则动词需单独记忆

examples.en: My wife and I were at the race.
She said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!'

grammar.title: 方位表达：on the left/right
grammar.structure: on the left / on the right
grammar.definition: 表示在某物的左边或右边 用于描述位置，常与standing、sitting等动词连用

examples.en: We are standing on the left.
The shop is on the right side of the street.

original.en: He was in car number fifteen.

translations.69:
在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。1995年举行了一次盛大的比赛。
许许多多人都去了赛场。我和我的妻子也去了。我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也去了。你可以在人群中看到我们。我们站在左面。
参加比赛的有20辆汽车。有英国、法国、德国、意大利、美国和日本的汽车。
比赛的结尾是激动人心的。获胜者是比利.斯图尔特。他在第15号车里，其他5辆汽车跟在他后面。
在回家的途中，我妻子对我说：“别开得这样快！你可不是比利.斯图尔特！”

lines.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
In 1995, there was a very big race.
There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
Our friends, Julie and Jack were there, too.
You can see us in the crowd.
We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
On the way home, my wife said to me, “Don’t drive so quickly!

lead.summary: 在我们镇子附近每年都有一场汽车比赛。1995年举行了一次盛大的比赛。
